summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated on is_terminal and returning bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py (skipped on Windows), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Nothing was run: tests and Black were not executed per the instructions, and nothing was committed. Assumption: the changelog link uses the standard github.com/Textualize/rich/pull/2200 URL.
